guide.text: Deathstroke's signature gear. Increases Energy gain for more Ultimate casts and provides a Physical Penetration bonus against low-HP targets. Defeating an enemy with his Ultimate grants [Funeral], increasing Attack and restoring HP. This is ideal for an Assassin with high single-target damage who excels at finishing enemies.
